children: Immersion Corp reported first-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $294.4M and diluted EPS of $0.17, driven largely by performance at Barnes & Noble Education and stable royalty and licensing income.
Revenue was $294.4M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $292.0M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 0.8%.
Net income attributable to Immersion stockholders was $4.9M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus a loss of $0.9M in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted earnings per share were $0.17 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $(0.03) in the year‑ago quarter.
Total consolidated revenue was modestly higher at $294.4M, driven primarily by Barnes & Noble Education's revenue of $290.6M, up 1% year-over-year.
Barnes & Noble Education growth was supported by BNC First Day® programs and e-commerce gains, partially offset by declines from closed stores; the chain operates 1,062 physical and virtual stores.
Operational improvements included better comparable-store and new-store sales, reduced operating expenses and lower rental cost of sales at Barnes & Noble Education.
Immersion continued to generate stable royalty and license revenues and remains focused on investing in its IP portfolio (approximately 300 patents) and haptic technology licensing.
